tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed an appeal before CESTAT and awaiting hearing.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: As part of the Income Tax Assessment, Company received assessment order u/s 143(3) of the IT Act for AY 2017-18 with a demand of Rs.46.44 Million due to non-submission of FORM 3CL for R&D expenses claimed u/s 35(2AB), deductions not allowed u/s 80G.

timeline.summary: Apparao V Mallavarapu (Promoter) declared no encumbrance or pledge on Centum Electronics shares as of March 31, 2026.
CRISIL revised Centum Electronics' outlook to Positive from Stable on ₹399.7 Cr bank loan facilities.
Centum Electronics scheduled its board meeting for May 14, 2026, to approve Q4 and FY26 financial results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹340.43 Cr, net profit ₹1.64 Cr (includes ₹33.36 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹35 Cr).
Centum Electronics filed its Monitoring Agency Report for QIP proceeds for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Centum Electronics submitted its Reg 32 statement reporting nil deviation in ₹210 Cr QIP proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Centum Electronics presented Q4FY26 earnings, reporting FY26 order book of ₹1,645 Cr (+22.7% YoY) and updating on European and Canadian portfolio restructuring.
Centum Electronics Limited uploaded the audio recording of its 15 May 2026 conference call with analysts/investors at 14:00 IST on its website.

Centum Electronics' 15 May 2026 Q4FY26 call transcript: management held its 25-30% medium-term standalone growth and 13-15% EBITDA margin targets, guided FY27 capex of ₹40-45 Cr, and said the European asset sale should conclude by July 2026 with deconsolidation by Q1/Q2 FY27.

Centum Electronics' May 2026 investor presentation reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹973 Cr and a ₹117 Cr loss after a ₹203 Cr exceptional item; with BTS order book up 28% to ₹1,645 Cr and a ₹570+ Cr HAL AESA Radar order.
